plainText:
Tōru Furuya (Japanese: 古谷徹 Furuya Tōru) is a Japanese voice actor for . He is also sometimes credited as Noboru Sōgetsu (蒼月 昇 Sōgetsu Noboru).

==Biography==
Furuya was born on July 31, 1953, in , , . He already started an acting career as a child, being part of the children's acting troupe . As an adult, he started landing a number of famous roles, usually in anime series. Furuya occasionally provided his voice for since , though he was best known as the Castelia City Gym Leader Burgh, who appeared in . He is currently affiliated with the talent agency . He was married to fellow voice actress from 1976 to 1983, and is now married to another voice actress, Satomi Majima.
